class.name: GameState
class.brief_description: Base class for a stackable game state. Intended to be inherited by game-specific state scenes (menus, gameplay, pause, etc.). Provides lifecycle hooks that the GameStateManager calls when states are entered, exited, or updated each frame.
class.description:
This class represents a single state in the game's state stack. A `GameState` is a `Node` that exposes three lifecycle callbacks that derived scenes may implement in GDScript or C++:
- `_on_enter()` is invoked when the state becomes active (pushed). - `_on_exit()` is invoked when the state is removed (popped). - `_on_update(delta)` is invoked each frame while the state is active.
The `update_underneath` property controls whether states below the top of the stack should also receive update callbacks while this state is active.

method.name: _on_enter
method.description: Called when this state becomes the active top state. Override to perform initialization or show animations.

method.name: _on_exit
method.description: Called when this state is removed from the stack. Override to perform cleanup and stop running logic.

method.name: _on_update
method.description: Called each frame with the frame delta while this state is active. Override to implement per-frame logic.
